title: Pia Carrot e Youkoso!! 2
native_title: Ｐｉａ♥キャロットへようこそ！！２
overview:
Pia Carrot e Youkoso!! 2 is a romance adventure and training simulation set at the family restaurant Pia Carrot, which has done well enough to open a second branch. You play Koji Maeda, who talks his way into a summer part-time job there - only to be shadowed by his new co-worker Azusa, who has had him down as a pervert ever since an awkward run-in on the street. Each day splits into morning, afternoon and after-work periods: use your free mornings to study, exercise or head into town, work your shift in the afternoon, and chat with the girls after work. Doing well at your tasks builds up stats such as style, kindness, guts, academics and stamina, and the Saturn version adds an extra heroine with her own story.

- Two discs: game disc and special disc
- Extended RAM Cartridge (1MB or 4MB) support for faster loading
- Single player
- Memory backup save
- Rated for ages 18 and over
